hints.content: The arrow points to all values less than $3$.
So, the inequality represents everything **less than $3$.**

question.content:
**Choose the inequality that represents the following graph.**


[[☃ image 1]]

[[☃ radio 1]]

options.alt: A number line from negative 5 to 5 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at 3. A line running to the left starts at 3 and continues.

choices.clue:
The graph of $x>-3$ actually looks like this:

![A number line from negative 5 to 5 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at negative 3. A line running to the right starts at negative 3 and continues.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/63819088bb1652f01adb0f0486171a729136247d)

The graph of $x>2$ actually looks like this:

![A number line from negative 5 to 5 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at 2. A line running to the right starts at 2 and continues.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/f78384402a1afb056efb0c24f2bcb27a8e1437a6)

The graph of $x < 4$ actually looks like this:

![A number line from negative 5 to 5 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at 4. A line running to the left starts at 4 and continues.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/3bcf9457a8ccfcc572a451a55eb860060c5ad671)
